title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: private deployments require a hardened, repeatable Terraform module to provision the Private Control Plane VPC across multiple AZs with appropriate networking primitives (subnets, interface endpoints, security groups), cross-account VPC peering for multi-account installs, and Route53 private hosted zone association. This change consolidates previous ad-hoc scripts into a single idempotent Terraform module and adds integration tests and docs.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds terraform/control-plane module that provisions: multi-AZ private subnets, NAT gateways (optional), route tables, interface endpoints for SSM/EC2/ECR/STS necessary for on-prem/VPC control plane nodes to bootstrap and pull images, control-plane security groups with least-privilege rules, and optionally creates a VPC peering connection + route updates.
- Adds Route53 private hosted zone association support for cross-account peering via aws_route53_zone_association (configurable). If the hosted zone is in a different account, the module emits instructions and outputs to assist manual association or cross-account automation.
- Adds variables to support mapping AZs, CIDR sizing, existing VPC import behavior, and peering acceptor configuration (cross-account).
- Adds terraform plan/validate CI job and tflint checks.
- Updates private-installer/README.md with deploy steps, IAM prerequisites and post-deploy checklists.
- Adds integration test harness that spins up the module in a sandbox account (test flagged in CI as integration/aws-private-control-plane).

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform module implemented and unit-tested (tflint/validate)
- [x] Integration test added and passing in sandbox CI (recorded below)
- [x] Documentation updated: README and examples
- [x] Migration strategy documented for existing customers (no forced replacement of existing VPCs)

Notes on migration and idempotency:
- The module supports providing an existing VPC ID. In that case it will create subnets and attachments inside the existing VPC and will not attempt to modify unrelated route tables.
- Peering is optional and defaults to false. For cross-account peering, the module outputs peering_request_id and instructions for acceptance in the target account. Automatic cross-account acceptance is not performed by this change.
- Route53 private hosted zone association across accounts requires appropriate IAM permissions (route53:AssociateVPCWithHostedZone) in the hosted zone account. The README has sample IAM policy.

Security considerations:
- Security groups created here are scoped to control-plane components and only allow required ports (SSH restricted to admin CIDRs, etc.).
- Interface endpoints are used to reduce internet exposure for image pulls and SSM. Endpoint policies are configurable but default to minimal required actions.

Rollback/upgrade notes:
- Destroying the module will remove peering connections and disassociate hosted zones; to rollback safely, run terraform plan and manually verify changes. We added an upgrade hook in the helm chart to wait for network readiness before control-plane bootstrap.

Known limitations / follow-ups: 
- Cross-account Route53 automatic association is tracked as a follow-up (ENG-7821).
- Additional automation to accept peering requests in the peer account will be a separate opt-in module.

Testing performed:
- terraform validate + tflint in CI (passed)
- integration/aws-private-control-plane ran in a sandbox account (passed, see CI logs)
- Manual smoke test: deployed to existing VPC, created peering connection and verified route propagation to control-plane subnets

References: linear/ENG-7821, internal docs/private-installer/networking.md

release_notes: Adds a new terraform module for Private Control Plane VPC provisioning: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints for SSM/ECR/STS, scoped security groups, optional cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone association instructions.
changelog_entry: Added terraform/control-plane module to provision VPC, subnets, endpoints, sgs, optional peering and Route53 association for private control plane installs. See private-installer/README.md for deploy steps and IAM prerequisites.
